subject: ddl: refactor V2 args for RebaseAutoID/Modify-table/Index-visibility/FK related DDL. (#56164)
summary: Refactors several DDL job arguments (RebaseAutoID/ModifyTable*/AlterIndexVisibility/Add/DropForeignKey) into typed JobArgs with V1/V2-compatible getters, updates executor submission to pass JobArgs via JobWrapperWithArgs for multi-schema-change bookkeeping, and adds an assertion guarding invalid Job.Version in Job.FillArgs. No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched DDL/meta paths relative to first parent.
